children: RNS Number : 2952D  Sanctuary Capital PLC  16 November 2026
Sanctuary agrees sale of student accommodation properties

Sanctuary has agreed to sell a 75% interest in a portfolio of 12 student accommodation properties to a joint venture between specialist student accommodation investment manager Global Student Accommodation (GSA), part of The Dot Group, and an institutional investor. Completion is expected within two weeks, subject to satisfaction of certain conditions.

Craig Moule, Sanctuary Group Chief Executive, said: “This agreement enables us to unlock capital from our successful student accommodation business for reinvestment in our core social housing activities, while retaining a 25% interest in the joint venture and continuing to benefit from its future success.”
For further information please visit the Sanctuary Group website: Sanctuary | Leading Housing and Care Provider.
